name: Reading
appliesTo: Here you can find the term dates for Reading's maintained schools. Please note that these are the dates for schools under Reading Local Authority control.
academyNote: Academies, free schools and other own admissions authority schools are free to set their own dates so these may be different.

localFacts.fact: Reading's school term dates are published by Brighter Futures for Children, which runs children's services for Reading Borough Council; the council's own term dates page points there.
The dates apply to schools under Reading Local Authority control; academies, free schools and other own admissions authority schools can set their own.
Reading numbers its year in six terms and fixes the first day of Term 1 as an inset day: Tuesday 1 September 2026, with pupils returning on Wednesday 2 September.
In 2027-28 the first day, Thursday 2 September 2027, is an inset day and pupils return on Friday 3 September.
Schools can set further training (inset) days when they are closed to pupils, and these may differ from school to school.
In 2027-28 Term 4 runs to Friday 7 April 2028 and Term 5 starts on Monday 24 April 2028, a week after Easter Monday.
The calendars total 195 days each year, for example 39, 35, 30, 24, 34 and 33 days across the six terms of 2026-27.

2026-27.insetNote: Term 1 starts with an inset day on Tuesday 1 September 2026 (schools return Wednesday 2 September). Schools can set a number of training (inset) days, which may be different in each school.
2026-27.notes: Term day counts on the calendar: 39, 35, 30, 24, 34 and 33 days (195).

2027-28.insetNote: Term 1 starts with an inset day on Thursday 2 September 2027 (schools return Friday 3 September); other inset days are set by each school.
2027-28.notes: Term day counts on the calendar: 37, 35, 29, 35, 24 and 35 days (195). Holidays are the gaps between the published terms.
